observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class QueryRanConcurrently with status 503 and a default message, alongside other ClickHouse and query-related exceptions.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a standardized exception type for the case where a query was already running and could not be reused, replacing the previous use of a generic AttributeError or similar. This could help distinguish this failure from other transient or permanent failures, potentially improving error handling and user-facing messages.

observations.behavior: Adds a new module implementing Redis-based single-flight query deduplication, including shared failure and result publication, heartbeat and polling, and Prometheus metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, bounded, Redis-backed flight mechanism for HogQL query cache, collapsing concurrent blocking executions of one cache key onto one leader, with follower wait and shared failure handling.

observations.behavior: Adds cache-key differentiation for pagination and execution-time parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Tracing aggregation queries use cache keys to avoid redundant ClickHouse execution; this hunk asserts that pagination parameters (limit, offset) and execution-time settings are included in the cache key, preventing shared cache entries between different pages or execution-time configurations.
